const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboWits align_blocks controller for the eai-standard/2.2 client.
+
+The default command inspects the calibrated ego RGB-D image and writes a plan.
+Use `hover`, `pick`, then `place` to execute the recorded manipulation in
+separate, inspectable phases. All object locations come from camera pixels and
+depth; the script does not request simulator object state.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.ndimage import label, find_objects
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+PLAN_FILE = OUT / "plan.json"
+VERTICAL_Q = np.array([0.0, 2**-0.5, 2**-0.5, 0.0], dtype=float)
+
+
+def camera_world_points(obs, camera: str, u: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray, z: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    E = np.eye(4)
+    E[:3, :4] = np.asarray(cam["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    pixels = np.vstack((u, v, np.ones_like(u)))
+    xyz_cam = (np.linalg.inv(K) @ pixels).T * z[:, None]
+    xyz_world = (np.linalg.inv(E) @ np.column_stack((xyz_cam, np.ones(len(z)))).T).T[:, :3]
+    return xyz_world
+
+
+def detect_cubes(obs) -> list[dict]:
+    """Find the three blue cube top faces from RGB connected components + depth."""
+    rgb = obs.last["ego"]
+    depth = obs.last_depth["ego"]
+    # Blue cube pixels; the table is white and the ruler is dark/red.
+    mask = ((rgb[:, :, 2] > 120) & (rgb[:, :, 2] > rgb[:, :, 0] * 1.08) &
+            (rgb[:, :, 0] > 60) & (rgb[:, :, 1] > 90) &
+            (rgb[:, :, 1] > rgb[:, :, 0] * 1.06))
+    labels, n = label(mask)
+    found = []
+    for idx, sl in enumerate(find_objects(labels), 1):
+        if sl is None:
+            continue
+        vv, uu = np.where(labels[sl] == idx)
+        vv = vv + sl[0].start
+        uu = uu + sl[1].start
+        if len(uu) < 200:
+            continue
+        z = depth[vv, uu]
+        valid = (z > 0.3) & (z < 1.2)
+        uu, vv, z = uu[valid], vv[valid], z[valid]
+        if len(uu) < 180:
+            continue
+        xyz = camera_world_points(obs, "ego", uu.astype(float), vv.astype(float), z.astype(float))
+        # The blue top faces sit above the white tabletop. Reject distant blue
+        # pixels/background artifacts without using any hidden scene state.
+        med = np.median(xyz, axis=0)
+        if not (0.77 < med[2] < 0.9):
+            continue
+        found.append({
+            "center_top_xyz": np.mean(xyz, axis=0).tolist(),
+            "pixel_bbox": [int(uu.min()), int(vv.min()), int(uu.max()), int(vv.max())],
+            "pixel_count": int(len(uu)),
+        })
+    found.sort(key=lambda x: (x["center_top_xyz"][0], x["center_top_xyz"][1]))
+    if len(found) != 3:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 3 visible blue cube components; detected {len(found)}: {found}")
+    return found
+
+
+def estimate_table_z(obs) -> float:
+    """Estimate table plane from white table pixels in a clear central patch."""
+    rgb, depth = obs.last["ego"], obs.last_depth["ego"]
+    vv, uu = np.mgrid[330:380, 350:550]
+    c = rgb[vv, uu]
+    z = depth[vv, uu]
+    keep = ((c[:, :, 0] > 190) & (c[:, :, 1] > 190) & (c[:, :, 2] > 190) &
+            (z > 0.3) & (z < 1.2))
+    if keep.sum() < 100:
+        raise RuntimeError("Could not find enough clear tabletop pixels to estimate its height")
+    xyz = camera_world_points(obs, "ego", uu[keep].astype(float), vv[keep].astype(float), z[keep].astype(float))
+    return float(np.median(xyz[:, 2]))
+
+
+def build_plan(obs) -> dict:
+    cubes = detect_cubes(obs)
+    table_z = estimate_table_z(obs)
+    centers = np.array([c["center_top_xyz"][:2] for c in cubes], dtype=float)
+    # Move the cube farthest from the line through the most widely separated
+    # pair. Place it beyond the nearer projected endpoint so its footprint
+    # remains clear of the other cubes.
+    pair = None
+    max_d = -1.0
+    for i in range(3):
+        for j in range(i + 1, 3):
+            d = np.linalg.norm(centers[j] - centers[i])
+            if d > max_d:
+                max_d, pair = d, (i, j)
+    i, j = pair
+    other = next(k for k in range(3) if k not in pair)
+    a, b, c = centers[i], centers[j], centers[other]
+    vec = b - a
+    length = np.linalg.norm(vec)
+    unit = vec / length
+    t = float(np.dot(c - a, vec) / (length * length))
+    if t < 0.5:
+        target_xy = a - 0.09 * unit
+    else:
+        target_xy = b + 0.09 * unit
+    top_z = float(np.median([x["center_top_xyz"][2] for x in cubes]))
+    center_z = (table_z + top_z) / 2.0
+    return {
+        "cubes": cubes,
+        "table_z_m": table_z,
+        "top_z_m": top_z,
+        "grasp_center_z_m": center_z,
+        "pair_indices": [i, j],
+        "move_index": other,
+        "pair_distance_m": float(length),
+        "projection_t": t,
+        "pick_xy_m": centers[other].tolist(),
+        "place_xy_m": target_xy.tolist(),
+        "place_margin_m": 0.09,
+        "created_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
+    }
+
+
+def load_plan() -> dict:
+    return json.loads(PLAN_FILE.read_text())
+
+
+def save_result(res, name: str) -> None:
+    path = OUT / "runs" / name
+    res.save(str(path))
+    brief = {
+        "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+        "stopped": res.meta.get("stopped"),
+        "executed_rows": res.meta.get("executed_rows"),
+        "control_steps_chunk": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+        "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),
+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+    }
+    print(name, json.dumps(brief))
+
+
+def fresh(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    return obs, np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+
+
+def ee_move(robot, xyz, quat, grip=0.09, name="move"):
+    obs, p = fresh(robot)
+    right = np.r_[p[16:23], p[7]]
+    left = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), np.asarray(quat, dtype=float), float(grip)]
+    row = np.r_[right, left].astype(np.float32)
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", row, video="mp4", video_fps=5, note=name)
+    save_result(res, name)
+    return res
+
+
+def hold_gripper(robot, opening: float, name: str, duration_s=1.0):
+    obs, p = fresh(robot)
+    state = p[:16].copy()
+    state[15] = opening
+    n = max(2, int(round(duration_s / 0.1)) + 1)
+    actions = np.repeat(state[None, :], n, axis=0)
+    res = robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.1, video="mp4", video_fps=5, note=name)
+    save_result(res, name)
+    return res
+
+
+def move_to_hover(robot, plan):
+    # Lift and reorient over the current hand position before translating above
+    # the cube, keeping the fingers safely clear of the tabletop.
+    obs, p = fresh(robot)
+    left0 = p[23:30]
+    ee_move(robot, [left0[0], left0[1], max(0.94, left0[2] + 0.08)], left0[3:7], 0.09, "hover_lift")
+    obs, p = fresh(robot)
+    ee_move(robot, [p[23], p[24], 0.94], VERTICAL_Q, 0.09, "hover_rotate")
+    px, py = plan["pick_xy_m"]
+    hover_z = max(0.91, plan["grasp_center_z_m"] + 0.12)
+    ee_move(robot, [px, py, hover_z], VERTICAL_Q, 0.09, "hover_pick")
+
+
+def execute_pick(robot, plan):
+    px, py = plan["pick_xy_m"]
+    z = plan["grasp_center_z_m"]
+    ee_move(robot, [px, py, z], VERTICAL_Q, 0.09, "descend_pick")
+    hold_gripper(robot, 0.0, "close_gripper", 1.0)
+    ee_move(robot, [px, py, max(0.90, z + 0.12)], VERTICAL_Q, 0.0, "lift_cube")
+
+
+def execute_place(robot, plan):
+    tx, ty = plan["place_xy_m"]
+    z = plan["grasp_center_z_m"]
+    ee_move(robot, [tx, ty, max(0.91, z + 0.12)], VERTICAL_Q, 0.0, "hover_place")
+    ee_move(robot, [tx, ty, z], VERTICAL_Q, 0.0, "descend_place")
+    hold_gripper(robot, 0.09, "open_gripper", 1.0)
+    if not robot.status().get("done"):
+        ee_move(robot, [tx, ty, max(0.91, z + 0.12)], VERTICAL_Q, 0.09, "retreat")
+
+
+def main():
+    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "inspect"
+    robot = Robot()
+    if phase == "inspect":
+        obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+        (OUT / "initial_obs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        obs.save(str(OUT / "initial_obs"))
+        plan = build_plan(obs)
+        PLAN_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2))
+        print(json.dumps({"plan": plan, "status": robot.status()}, indent=2))
+        # Check the arm can reach every recorded waypoint before it moves.
+        p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        q14 = p[:14]
+        px, py = plan["pick_xy_m"]
+        tx, ty = plan["place_xy_m"]
+        z, hover = plan["grasp_center_z_m"], max(0.91, plan["grasp_center_z_m"] + 0.12)
+        checks = {
+            "high": [p[23], p[24], 0.94],
+            "pick_hover": [px, py, hover],
+            "pick": [px, py, z],
+            "place_hover": [tx, ty, hover],
+            "place": [tx, ty, z],
+        }
+        for name, xyz in checks.items():
+            ik = robot.ik({"Gripper_Tip_L": [*xyz, *VERTICAL_Q]}, seed=q14)
+            print("IK", name, ik.get("ok"), ik.get("error"))
+            if not ik.get("ok"):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"Left-arm IK failed for {name}: {ik}")
+        return
+    plan = load_plan()
+    print("STATUS", json.dumps(robot.status()))
+    if phase == "hover":
+        move_to_hover(robot, plan)
+    elif phase == "pick":
+        execute_pick(robot, plan)
+    elif phase == "place":
+        execute_place(robot, plan)
+    elif phase == "all":
+        move_to_hover(robot, plan)
+        execute_pick(robot, plan)
+        execute_place(robot, plan)
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: gen.py [inspect|hover|pick|place|all]")
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    obs.save(str(OUT / ("after_" + phase)))
+    print("FINAL_STATUS", json.dumps(robot.status()))
+    print("TCP_NOW", np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"])[16:30].tolist())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
